tasks: Implement merge_intervals(intervals): merge closed integer intervals that overlap or touch at an endpoint. Return sorted [start,end] lists. Do not mutate input. Reject an interval with start > end with ValueError.

Implement toposort(nodes, edges). Nodes are unique strings; edges are (source,target) pairs. Return lexicographically smallest topological ordering. Include isolated nodes; ignore duplicate edges. Raise ValueError for a cycle or an edge referencing an unknown node.

Implement json_pointer(doc, pointer) for RFC6901 JSON pointers. Empty pointer returns doc. Nonempty pointer must start /. Decode ~1 to slash and ~0 to tilde, rejecting other ~ escapes with ValueError. Dict keys are literal strings. List indices must be nonnegative decimal without leading zeros (except 0); reject - or out of range with ValueError. Missing dict keys and traversal through scalars raise ValueError.

Implement shortest_path(n, edges, source, target) for a directed graph with vertices 0..n-1 and nonnegative numeric weights. Return shortest distance, or None when unreachable. Reject negative weights with ValueError even in unreachable components. Duplicate edges are allowed; zero weights allowed. Use an efficient priority queue approach.

assert f(4,[(0,1,9),(0,2,1),(2,1,1),(1,3,2)],0,3)==4
assert f(3,[(0,1,0),(0,1,5),(1,2,0)],0,2)==0
assert f(3,[],0,2) is None
assert f(1,[],0,0)==0
try: f(4,[(2,3,-1)],0,1)
except ValueError: pass
else: raise AssertionError('negative')

Implement split_quoted(line) for one CSV-like row: comma delimiters, double-quoted fields may contain commas, doubled double-quotes inside quoted fields mean a literal quote. Unquoted fields cannot contain quotes; nothing except comma or end may follow a closing quote. Preserve whitespace. Empty line is one empty field. Reject malformed quoting with ValueError. Do not use the csv module.

Fix and implement longest_unique(text): return the length of the longest substring without repeated Unicode characters in O(n) time. A previous implementation moved its left boundary backwards on repeated characters outside the current window. Handle empty strings, repeated characters and non-ASCII correctly.
